flags.model_translation: Don't give your number to anyone
flags.model_justification: This is a safety warning advising against sharing contact information.

flags.model_excerpt: ನಾನು ನಂಬರ್ ಕೊಟ್ರೆ ಇದರೊಳಗೆ ಯಾರೋ ಅನ್ನೋನ್ ಇರ್ತಾರೆ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಿರ್ತಾರೆ ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ ವಾಟ್ಸಪ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂಗ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ
flags.model_translation: If I give my number, there will be unknown people inside, they will keep calling, messaging, and doing this on WhatsApp.
flags.model_justification: This is a warning about the risks of sharing a phone number, mentioning WhatsApp.
flags.model_context: The expert explains why they don't share their number, mentioning unwanted calls and messages on WhatsApp. The user listens.
